principle: Never hard-code a single legacy percentage. Every coefficient/rate must come from a versioned CostRuleSet selected by date, location, project type and discipline.

supported_patterns: unit conversion mm->m, kg->t, m2->100m2, m3->100m3

variables.Glt: Temporary works / site facilities where applicable
variables.Gdt: Estimated construction cost / final rule output

norm_code: Canonicalize variants such as AF11121 and AF.11121 to a configured canonical form.
Treat GTT and other custom codes as custom-priced items unless mapped by user.
Do not infer work name only from prefix.
text_encoding: Detect Unicode vs legacy VNI/TCVN3-like text.
Never overwrite raw source text during import.
unit: Normalize synonyms/case: M3/m3, M2/m2, Tấn/Taán, Công/C«ng, Cái/Caùi, Bộ/Boä.
Reject implicit conversions when dimension differs.

validation: Each estimate item must have work name, unit and quantity unless it is a heading/subtotal.
Normalized norm code must map to exactly one active norm version or be flagged unresolved.
For norm-based items, resource breakdown must reconcile to item material/labor/machine unit price within tolerance.
Quantity equals sum(quantity lines) within tolerance.
Amount equals quantity * unit price for composite-price rows.
No current calculation may silently use an expired rule set.
External workbook links or #NAME? / #REF! values must be flagged.
Negative quantity lines are allowed only as documented deductions.
Price source, date and location are required for auditable resource prices.
